notes: Citizen 3D World Models: Planet Lab's Local view can now draw citizens as rigged 3D models instead of flat sprites. Cato is first: his Blender model plays an Idle loop when standing and a Walk loop while he travels a route (Idle when the sim is paused or he arrives), and turns to face where he is going. Models are presentation only; the Simulation still owns every position, and markers still handle names, clicks, and selection. If a model, WebGL, or three.js fails to load, that citizen keeps the sprite body. three.js is bundled locally so the world works offline. Other citizens gain a 3D body by adding their own model file. No Simulation authority, citizen behavior rules, world truth, or autonomy changes.
